name: @knowget/gateway
description: API Gateway & Integration Fabric (P3-D01) — the first contract of Phase 3 and the platform's entire external surface, inbound and outbound. Thirty domain contracts modelled what the institution does; this one decides what any of it is allowed to look like from outside, and its rule is that the platform exposes capabilities and never implementation. A published contract is immutable and a route's internal target is unprojectable, so the shape an integrator builds against cannot drift when the domain behind it is refactored, and no consumer can acquire a dependency on where a capability happens to live. Nothing here holds a clock, an unseeded random source, an HTTP client or a credential: every retry schedule is a pure function of the delivery identity, every secret is a reference resolved at the composition root, and every external system sits behind a replaceable adapter. Domain events carry ids, keys, versions, statuses, decisions, reason codes and counts only — never a payload, a header, a secret or a URL.
